text_en: As he came out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Look, Teacher, what large stones and what large buildings! ”
text_cn: 耶稣从圣殿里出来的时候，他的门徒中有一个对他说：“师傅！看，这是何等的石头！何等的建筑！”

text_en: Then Jesus asked him, “Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone will be left here upon another; all will be thrown down. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“你看见这些伟大的建筑吗？将来这里决没有一块石头留在另一块石头上，而不被拆毁的。”

text_en: When he was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,
text_cn: 耶稣在橄榄山上，面对圣殿坐着的时候，伯多禄、雅各伯、若望和安德肋私下问他说：

text_en: “Tell us, when will this be, and what will be the sign that all these things are about to be accomplished? ”
text_cn: “请告诉我们：什么时候发生这些事？这一切事要完成时，将有什么先兆？”

text_en: Then Jesus began to say to them, “Beware that no one leads you astray.
text_cn: 耶稣就开始对他们说：“你们要谨慎，免得有人欺骗了你们。

text_en: Many will come in my name and say, ‘I am he! ’ and they will lead many astray.
text_cn: 将有许多人假冒我的名字来说：我就是（默西亚）；并且要欺骗许多人。

text_en: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed; this must take place, but the end is still to come.
text_cn: 当你们听到战争和战争的风声时，不要惊慌，因为这是必须发生的，但还不是结局。

text_en: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there will be earthquakes in various places; there will be famines. This is but the beginning of the birth pangs.
text_cn: 因为民族要起来攻击民族，国家攻击国家；到处要有地震，要有饥荒；但这只是苦痛的开始。”

text_en: “As for yourselves, beware; for they will hand you over to councils; and you will be beaten in synagogues; and you will stand before governors and kings because of me, as a testimony to them.
text_cn: “你们自己要谨慎！人要把你们解送到公议会，你们在会堂里要受鞭打，并且也要为我的原故，站在总督和君王面前，对他们作证。

text_en: And the good news must first be proclaimed to all nations.
text_cn: 但福音必须先传于万国。

text_en: When they bring you to trial and hand you over, do not worry beforehand about what you are to say; but say whatever is given you at that time, for it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
text_cn: 人把你们拉去解送到法庭时，你们不要预先思虑该说什么；在那时刻赐给你们什么话，你们就说什么，因为说话的不是你们，而是圣神。

text_en: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child, and children will rise against parents and have them put to death;
text_cn: 兄弟将把兄弟，父亲将把儿子置于死地；儿女将起来反对父母，把他们处死。

text_en: and you will be hated by all because of my name. But the one who endures to the end will be saved.
text_cn: 你们为了我的名字，将为众人所恼恨；但那坚持到底的，必要得救。”

text_en: “But when you see the desolating sacrilege set up where it ought not to be (let the reader understand), then those in Judea must flee to the mountains;
text_cn: “几时你们看见那‘招致荒凉的可憎之物’立在不应在的地方──读者应明白；那时在犹太的，该逃往山中；

text_en: the one on the housetop must not go down or enter the house to take anything away;
text_cn: 在屋顶上的，不要下来，也不要进去，从屋里取什么东西；

text_en: the one in the field must not turn back to get a coat.
text_cn: 在田地里的，不要回来取自己的外衣。

text_en: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who are nursing infants in those days!
text_cn: 在那些日子里，怀孕的和哺乳的是有祸的！

text_en: Pray that it may not be in winter.
text_cn: 但你们当祈祷，不要叫这事逢到冬天。”

text_en: For in those days there will be suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the creation that God created until now, no, and never will be.
text_cn: “因为在那些日子里，必有灾难，这是从天主创造开始，直到如今从未有过的，将来也不会再有。

text_en: And if the Lord had not cut short those days, no one would be saved; but for the sake of the elect, whom he chose, he has cut short those days.
text_cn: 若不是上主缩短了那些时日，凡有血肉的人都不会得救；但为了他所拣选的被选者，他缩短了那些时日。

text_en: And if anyone says to you at that time, ‘Look! Here is the Messiah! ’ or ‘Look! There he is! ’—do not believe it.
text_cn: 那时，若有人对你们说：看，默西亚在这里！看，在那里！你们不要相信！

text_en: False messiahs and false prophets will appear and produce signs and omens, to lead astray, if possible, the elect.
text_cn: 因为将有假默西亚和假先知兴起，行异迹和奇事，如果可能的话，他们连被选者都要欺骗。

text_en: But be alert; I have already told you everything.
text_cn: 所以，你们要谨慎！看，凡事我都预先告诉了你们！

text_en: “But in those days, after that suffering, the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light,
text_cn: 但是，在那些日子里，在那灾难以后，太阳将要昏暗，月亮不再发光；

text_en: and the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.
text_cn: 星辰要从天上坠下，天上的万象也要动摇。

text_en: Then they will see ‘the Son of Man coming in clouds’ with great power and glory.
text_cn: 那时，人要看见人子带着大威能和光荣乘云降来。

text_en: Then he will send out the angels, and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
text_cn: 那时，他要派遣天使，由四方，从地极到天边，聚集他的被选者。”

text_en: “From the fig tree learn its lesson: as soon as its branch becomes tender and puts forth its leaves, you know that summer is near.
text_cn: “你们应由无花果树取个比喻：几时它的枝条已经发嫩，生出叶子，你们就知道夏天近了。

text_en: So also, when you see these things taking place, you know that he is near, at the very gates.
text_cn: 同样，你们几时看见这些事发生了，就该知道：他已近在门口了。

text_en: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have taken place.
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：非到这一切发生了，这一世代决不会过去。

text_en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
text_cn: 天地要过去，但是我的话决不会过去。

text_en: “But about that day or hour no one knows, neither the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
text_cn: 至于那日子和那时刻，除了父以外，谁也不知道，连天上的天使和子都不知道。”

text_en: Beware, keep alert; for you do not know when the time will come.
text_cn: “你们要当心，要醒寤，因为你们不知道那日期什么时候来到。

text_en: It is like a man going on a journey, when he leaves home and puts his slaves in charge, each with his work, and commands the doorkeeper to be on the watch.
text_cn: 正如一个远行的人，离开自己的家时，把权柄交给了自己的仆人，每人有每人的工作；又嘱咐看门的须要醒寤。

text_en: Therefore, keep awake—for you do not know when the master of the house will come, in the evening, or at midnight, or at cockcrow, or at dawn,
text_cn: 所以，你们要醒寤，因为你们不知道，家主什么时候回来：或许傍晚，或许夜半，或许鸡叫，或许清晨；

text_en: or else he may find you asleep when he comes suddenly.
text_cn: 免得他忽然来到，遇见你们正在睡觉。

text_en: And what I say to you I say to all: Keep awake. ”
text_cn: 我对你们说的，我也对众人说：你们要醒寤！”
